retention.summary: evidence and configuration only; every class below is a row family of one unit's private MariaDB, and nothing is removed except the three cleanup classes (DECISIONS-20261011 §C)
retention.vault.secrets: unlimited — until deleted through Vault's administrative API
retention.vault.unit_identities: unlimited — a unit's current identity, incarnation, epoch and revocation are never removed automatically
retention.vault.unit_credentials (expired): cleanup class: a credential row expired for more than 24 hours is removed by Vault (pruneExpiredCredentials); a row marked revoked is kept
retention.<unit>.event_outbox (delivered): cleanup class: for vault, queue and maestro, a row delivered more than 30 days ago is removed only when it carries Logger's verified receipt and a recovery point recorded after a verified restore holds it (pruneDeliveredOutbox)
retention.<unit>.event_outbox (owed, invalid or fa: unlimited — a row without a receipt, set aside as OUTBOX_ROW_INVALID or still retrying is never removed automatically
retention.<unit>.recovery_points: unlimited — written by the administrative path after a verified restore
retention.sav/dumps (logical dumps): kept with the unit's sav volume; removed with it
retention.proof state: unlimited until the universe is terminated

dataLifecycle.onTermination: destroy every unit's declared volumes (etc/mysql, sav, and log where declared) and its etc/identity, the Vault master key, the universe identity, and the proof's state and reader identity; nothing is exported

description: The minimal composition: Vault, Logger, Queue and Maestro, each one functional Podman holding its application and its own MariaDB server, two processes in one container (Rules 4 and 26, Turbinobash method). No cognition adapter, no catalogue brick, no domain.

brick-vault.role: Protects secret material and delivers it to authorized callers

cognition.rationale: Deterministic secret storage and decryption. No model, ever.

brick-logger.role: Records events durably and proves what it received

cognition.rationale: Append-only structured evidence. No model, ever.

brick-queue.role: Durably holds deferred work until a terminal acknowledgement

cognition.rationale: Delivery is mechanical. Each job carries its own requirement, not the queue.

brick-maestro.role: Submits one idempotent occurrence to Queue for each due instant of a declared schedule; idle when none is declared

specialize.how: MAESTRO_TASKS_FILE points at this universe's task-schedule.json, mounted read-only at /apps/maestro/etc/task-schedule.json

cognition.rationale: Time, not orchestration: it computes due instants and submits typed jobs. It never executes work.
